items.title: Anthropic bans third-party AI clients from Claude subscriptions
items.summary: Starting April 4th, Claude subscriptions will no longer cover third-party access from tools like OpenClaw. Users must pay extra for API-based third-party integrations.

items.title: AI training data company Mercor hit by security breach
items.summary: Meta has paused work with AI training data firm Mercor after a data breach potentially exposed AI industry secrets. OpenAI is also investigating the security incident.

items.title: Elon Musk demands SpaceX IPO advisers subscribe to Grok
items.summary: Musk is reportedly requiring banks, law firms, and auditors working on the SpaceX IPO to purchase subscriptions to his Grok AI chatbot, now technically under the SpaceX umbrella.

items.title: US employers added 178,000 jobs in March, beating expectations
items.summary: American employers added a surprisingly strong 178,000 new jobs last month, rebounding from a dismal February. The unemployment rate dipped to 4.3%.

items.title: Trump unveils 100% tariff on some patented drugs on 'Liberation Day' anniversary
items.summary: The Trump administration announced sweeping 100% tariffs on certain patented pharmaceuticals as part of ongoing trade policy moves marking the anniversary of 'Liberation Day'.

items.title: Oil tops $110 a barrel as Iran war rattles global markets
items.summary: Stocks recovered from early losses to close with a weekly gain, but US oil surged past $110 a barrel amid deepening concerns over the Iran conflict's impact on global energy supply.

items.title: 2 US aircraft shot down as war in Iran escalates
items.summary: Two US military planes were shot down in separate incidents on Friday, including a fighter jet hit by Iran's air defenses. At least one crew member is reported missing.

items.title: UK gathers 40+ countries to press Iran to reopen Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Britain has assembled a coalition of more than 40 nations to pressure Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global oil shipping lane that has been disrupted by the ongoing conflict.

items.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill 8 as Kyiv holds door open for Easter truce
items.summary: Russia launched fresh aerial attacks on Ukraine killing at least 8 people, even as Kyiv signaled openness to an Easter ceasefire and an Easter prisoner exchange was being planned.
